headline: The prince now climbs by thumb — phones get the grab
lede: PRINCE OF PERSIA's signature ledge grammar — catch a fall, climb, shimmy, hang-jump — was keyboard-only. A phone player can finally hold ✋ and catch a ledge, because the shared pad learned a third held button.

notes.text: VirtualControls grew thirdAction: one held button beside (never inside — the pinned hit-test) the A/B zone, keydown on touch, keyup on release/hide. Games that don't pass it get byte-identical pads.

popplay's new phone page proves the chain with real touch: tap starts, thumb-right runs (vx 2.60), holding ✋ caps him to exactly the walk speed (1.45 = the Shift law), lifting hands the run back — one keydown, one keyup, zero page errors.

Never-dry rung again: queue, feedback and flagship stages were all held or owned; weakestStage aimed slot b at PRINCE OF PERSIA (#2324) and the oldest honest gap is now CLOSED. The QA polish pass is #2330.
Slot a shipped TEN-DEEP roaming packs (#2323) and tint plumbing (#2325) on the same shift — the two builders never touched one another's files.

look.text: Hold ✋ off a ledge on your phone — the prince catches himself
